purpose: Inventory of every source used for this library and every candidate found but not downloaded, so missing assets can be fetched later without re-searching. Original archives are NOT stored in this repo.
rules: Use only CC0 / CC BY (attribution) / explicitly commercial-OK licenses; skip CC BY-SA-only, QAL, NC, paid.
Verify license on the page before use; record it in AssetRegistry.json.
Prefer GLB/glTF; FBX 7.x; OBJ+MTL for static. .blend-only = unusable without Blender (excluded).
Run the three.js load check before adding (see 13_Metadata/threejs_load_test.json format).

access_notes.itch.io: free packs: POST <page>/file/<upload_id>?source=view_game&as_props=1 (csrf_token from page) -> {"url": signed CDN link}; paid packs return "you must buy"
access_notes.github.com: git clone works for public repos
access_notes.api.polyhaven.com: public API, send a normal User-Agent
access_notes.quaternius Google Drive: listing works (embeddedfolderview?id=<folder>) but files returned "Quota exceeded" on 2026-11-26; may work later or from a browser
access_notes.kenney.nl: HTTP 403 for automated clients; use OpenGameArt (Kenney account) or a browser

unavailable_sources.reason: Folder listing worked, but every file request returned Google Drive "Quota exceeded" (also for small License.txt files). Not retried in a loop. Packs that Quaternius also publishes on OpenGameArt/itch.io were taken from there instead.
HTTP 403 from the site for automated requests. Kenney's official OpenGameArt uploads (CC0) were used instead (some are older versions than kenney.nl; e.g. no "Mini Market" beyond Mini Shop 2.1).
Cloudflare browser challenge (HTTP 403, cf-mitigated: challenge). Not bypassed. Most Poly Pizza low-poly models are by Quaternius/Kenney, which were acquired from their official channels.
Downloads require a logged-in account; no credentials requested per brief.
